import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C = new long[75][75];
    static int n, m, total_len, half_point;
    static int[] constraints = new int[75];
    static List<long[]>[] memo_b = new List[55][55];
    static Map<Long, Long>[] memo_a = new Map[55][55];
    static long best_value = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long count_of_best = 0;

    static void init_binomials() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfs_memo_b(int pos, int cnt_a, int cnt_b, long current_sum) {
        if (pos == half_point) {
            memo_b[cnt_a][cnt_b].add(new long[]{current_sum, 1});
            return;
        }
        for (int choice = 0; choice < 2; choice++) {
            if (constraints[pos - 1] != -1 && choice != constraints[pos - 1]) continue;
            long contribution = 0;
            if (choice == 0) {
                if (cnt_a > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        contribution += C[cnt_a - 1][n - 1] * C[cnt_b][j] * C[total_len - pos][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_memo_b(pos - 1, cnt_a - 1, cnt_b, current_sum + contribution);
                }
            } else {
                if (cnt_b > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        contribution -= C[cnt_b - 1][n - 1] * C[cnt_a][j] * C[total_len - pos][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_memo_b(pos - 1, cnt_a, cnt_b - 1, current_sum + contribution);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void try_update(long value, long count) {
        if (value < best_value) {
            best_value = value;
            count_of_best = count;
        } else if (value == best_value) {
            count_of_best += count;
        }
    }

    static void bfs_memo_a() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                memo_a[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        memo_a[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : memo_a[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long key = entry.getKey();
                    long value = entry.getValue();
                    
                    if (i + j == half_point) {
                        List<long[]> list = memo_b[i][j];
                        int idx = lowerBound(list, -key);
                        if (idx < list.size()) {
                            try_update(Math.abs(key + list.get(idx)[0]), value * list.get(idx)[1]);
                        }
                        if (idx > 0) {
                            try_update(Math.abs(key + list.get(idx - 1)[0]), value * list.get(idx - 1)[1]);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int idx = i + j;
                        for (int choice = 0; choice < 2; choice++) {
                            if (constraints[idx] != -1 && choice != constraints[idx]) continue;
                            int a = i, b = j;
                            if (choice == 0) a++;
                            else b++;
                            if (a <= n + m && b <= n + m) {
                                long delta = 0;
                                if (choice == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        delta += C[a - 1][n - 1] * C[b][l] * C[total_len - idx - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        delta -= C[b - 1][n - 1] * C[a][l] * C[total_len - idx - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                memo_a[a][b].put(key + delta, memo_a[a][b].getOrDefault(key + delta, 0L) + value);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<long[]> list, long target) {
        int left = 0, right = list.size();
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid)[0] >= target) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }

    static void solve() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                memo_b[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        dfs_memo_b(total_len, n + m, n + m, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                Collections.sort(memo_b[i][j], (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                List<long[]> merged = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = memo_b[i][j].size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long key = memo_b[i][j].get(k)[0];
                    int total = 0;
                    while (k < sz && memo_b[i][j].get(k)[0] == key) {
                        total += memo_b[i][j].get(k)[1];
                        k++;
                    }
                    merged.add(new long[]{key, total});
                }
                memo_b[i][j] = merged;
            }
        }
        bfs_memo_a();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        init_binomials();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String buffer = br.readLine();
        
        total_len = (n + m) * 2;
        half_point = Math.max(0, total_len - 22);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                memo_b[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                memo_a[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        
        Arrays.fill(constraints, -1);
        solve();
        count_of_best = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < total_len; i++) {
            if (buffer.charAt(i) == 'A') constraints[i] = 0;
            else if (buffer.charAt(i) == 'B') constraints[i] = 1;
        }
        
        solve();
        System.out.println(count_of_best);
    }
}
